scope: Existing failure, launcher/installed bytes/plists, bounded existing installer logs/receipts and filtered process metadata. No xcrun/simctl/xcodebuild/device/installer/GUI invocation.
confirmedFacts: Captured xcrun simctl list --json timed out 10.003s with Install Started. No assigned-device boot requested. Xcode selection and Device Hub signature passed.

Selected simctl is a shell launcher. Missing/older installed CoreSimulator version than 1174.9.2 invokes selected xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch, followed by installed actual simctl. /usr/bin/xcrun is a native shim referencing _xcselect_invoke_xcrun; its full internals were not inspected.

Existing unified logs identify xcodebuild PID 54501 DVTFirstLaunchPackageInstaller electing bundled CoreTypes.pkg and XcodeSystemResources.pkg at 17:13:40 -0700. PackageKit starts two-package install 17:13:44, atomically replaces CoreSimulator 17:13:49, loses client 17:13:50, writes receipts 17:13:57, logs End install 17:13:59 and 14.8s elapsed.

Captured result mtime 2026-10-28T00:13:50.455352+00:00 matches client disappearance. Apple installation continued after timeout. cleanup:null refers to no assigned-device cleanup, not cancellation of installer activity.

Current CoreSimulator version 1174.9.2 equals launcher expectation. Installed actual simctl is Mach-O SHA ae4278fb72ecdbf17675011db81b85235acb1bfeffcfe812d01d87a0f42329ea. Receipts date the two package installations to 00:13:57UTC.
Later filtered process metadata shows no xcodebuild/simctl. Apple installer and CoreSimulator daemons remain; daemon presence alone establishes neither active installation nor health.
